steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The Black Ring is spreading rapidly, its radiation now blanketing the entire West District.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We've confirmed the presence of the Underground Shepherd, and she's dangerously close to the Black Ring border. At this rate, there's no way we can stop her from breaching BR-002.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: She wields tremendous power, stronger than any SHPs we've ever had in the history. We must halt her from consuming BR-002; otherwise, the outcome will be catastrophic.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: But amidst the failed observation and the disarray within the Ring's temporal field, we can't pinpoint the right moment to launch an attack, and it's equally challenging to trail her into the core of the Black Ring.

steps.speaker: High-Level Channel
steps.content: Actually, we can determine the timing.

steps.speaker: High-Level Channel
steps.content: It will occur precisely when BR-002 engulfs the entire West District's population, reaching its peak in power.

steps.speaker: High-Level Channel
steps.content: The Underground must be anticipating this very moment; it will propel them forward by a great leap, to a point we'll struggle to keep up with.

steps.speaker: High-Level Channel
steps.content: However, we have countermeasures. Firstly, we'll bide our time and confirm the exact moment when the Black Ring is breached. At that instant, the Underground Shepherd will also reveal herself. That's our cue for a focused attack.

steps.speaker: High-Level Channel
steps.content: Next, track down SHP-13. We've confirmed that he's regained consciousness. Locate him. His involvement is key to advancing our next step.
steps.female_content: Next, track down SHP-13. We've confirmed that she's regained consciousness. Locate her. Her involvement is key to advancing our next step.

steps.speaker: High-Level Channel
steps.content: Lastly, calculate the Black Ring's rate of expansion, right before it overtakes the West District...

steps.speaker: High-Level Channel
steps.content: Activate the local Purge Order.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: We couldn't stop it after all, could we... Employing the Purge Order is the "sensible" option here. You wouldn't want everyone in the West District to end up as her prey.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: But even that won't stop her...
(Scene change)
Crache gazes upon the erupting Black Ring, its ominous shadows engulfing the entire Syndicate beneath the High Tower of Mania.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...Haha, is this what they call... the future?
(Scene change)
Oak Casket cradles the unconscious Hecate from another's hold, watching him step into wild pollution and hearing the wails of lost souls.
steps.female_content: Oak Casket cradles the unconscious Hecate from another's hold, watching her step into wild pollution and hearing the wails of lost souls.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: This is the only form of equality you'll ever get.
[Scene Change] Maze Outside the Ring

BR-002's halo begins to expand slowly, radiating outward and gradually engulfing the contaminated areas beyond its ring. It dissolves those towering barriers, and the Corruptors emerge, now endowed with even greater strength.
Above them all, a more formidable presence looms, now unmasked and free to unleash her power.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: You, the humble Overgrounder, have... truly given your all. You've not only met but exceeded my expectations.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: While other misguided fools attempted to challenge the might of □□□, that Ring you crafted did prove to be a hindrance, quite the headache, I must admit.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: But now, it's time.

From the heart of the maze, a wooden staff strikes the ground, reverberating. Through the darkness, a figure presses onward, and with each stride, the towering maze walls on either side collapse. A more immense presence slowly encroaches upon the bottom of the Black Ring.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: Feel proud of the grandeur in your humble existence, and then find peace in fading.

steps.speaker: Old Lady
steps.content: You can place your trust in me for everything.
The Black Ring keeps expanding, stretching further, much like a long-neglected flower slowly unfurling itself and greedily soaking up nutrients.
Those nutrients are none other than the people of West District, mired in fear and despair beneath the radiant surface.

Amidst the wreckage, the old time hero stumbles along, his mind clouded, uncertain of his destination, yet persistently taking each arduous step forward, his back to the looming Black Ring, oblivious to where it all leads.
And when he finally falters and falls, another soul reaches out to help him up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You gave it your all, but it was still beyond your control.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is Syndicate's Black Ring, a destiny millions have chosen for decades, set in stone. Neither you nor I can alter its course.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Not on my watch.
Upon hearing his words, ${PlayerName}'s gaze dims a bit.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well... get ready then.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This isn't the end.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not by a long shot.
